correctness.rationale: For each v in the deleted rectangle T_t, an independent k-set appearing after adjoining the surviving hub u to a face σ containing v would imply an already-forbidden independent k-set after replacing u by v. Thus all such σ can adjoin u, vertices of T_t are strongly dominated and the simultaneous collapse v->u is contiguous with the identity and commutes with the preserving subgroup. The induced core is precisely K_{s+1,b−t}, so its robust clique complex is the join of (k−2)-simplex skeleta; standard integral wedge bases and exterior augmentation lattices give all top ranks and group modules. Natural core inclusions are split injections while both top ranks are nonzero, and final m=0 creates lower (k−2)-degree homology after a contractible plateau. Fresh independent exact face/retraction/Euler checks across 15 stages, k=4 and multiple shore sizes; general integral proof relies on explicit collapses, not mod-2 data.
residual_risks: Strong collapse is sequential; the stated subgroup-equivariant homotopy follows from the simultaneous canonical retraction/contiguity rather than an equivariant choice of vertex elimination order.
